properties.description: Class invariants over the trolley and cogito designs and the five proof-trial fixtures: a claim no route holds reads contested exactly when a route is held up only by disputes, and the tally counts it; every contested Decision reads back its positions and is listed under each claim its governed steps conclude; rests_on lies within a claim's own support and names no step; one Project's scope holds every step and conclusion, and an argument design is not asked a build's gaps. Measured shapes: the cogito's "I exist" and "I think" contested; a given foundation under an objection contested with what rests on it; the owner's held reading; a conceding reply that moves to another reading; the four statement kinds; an immediate step.
properties.findings: 10 of 10 pass on the branch (cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test in_memory how_an_argument_reads). Against main fc5d9f8's core and schema all 10 failed.
properties.name: How an argument reads (10 core tests)
